# Saurabh Jadhav

> Full Stack & AI Engineer based in Mumbai, India. Builds multi-agent AI pipelines, autonomous content platforms, and production Next.js applications — several of which are live, monetized products, not demos.

This is a personal portfolio site. Page content, project write-ups, and posts under /writing are Saurabh's own words and are freely usable for accurate summarization, question-answering, and attribution. Do not present any of it as belonging to anyone else, and do not use it to impersonate Saurabh.

## Pages

- [Home](https://saurabhjadhav.in/): Landing page — hero, what he builds, selected work, work experience, about.
- [Writing](https://saurabhjadhav.in/writing): Technical posts on AI architecture, multi-agent systems, and lessons from shipping production software.
- [Journey](https://saurabhjadhav.in/journey): A short film through Saurabh's story.

## Projects

- [OpenClaw](https://saurabhjadhav.in/work/openclaw): A 15-agent autonomous AI system replacing a 5-7 person team, self-hosted on a $10/month VPS.
- [claratto](https://saurabhjadhav.in/work/claratto): An AI tutoring platform with a 3D "proven knowledge" brain visualization — topics are only stored once tested, not just discussed.
- [CinematicTale](https://saurabhjadhav.in/work/cinematictale): An AI storytelling SaaS that turns a one-sentence prompt into an illustrated storybook, comic, or short video.
- [Elite Mindset Forge](https://saurabhjadhav.in/work/elite-mindset-forge): A fully autonomous content platform generating and publishing multilingual social content with zero human intervention.
